title: Step IV: Update the Other Vertices

blocks.content: Step IV: Update the Other Vertices
Now, we update the distance values of the remaining vertices that are connected to the vertices we previously visited.

blocks.alt: Compare the Path Length to Reach Adjacent Vertices of C

blocks.content: In the graph, all the remaining vertices are connected to vertex C. So, we can update all the remaining distances from vertex C instead of vertex A.
If we can reach a vertex from C, we can reach it from A. In such cases,
Distance of a vertex from A = (Distance of the vertex from C) + 4
Now, let's check if they have any alternate paths.
